decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers are a core component technology that feeds the firm's established cooler and service business, so keeping this option open costs little and it complements the remaining portfolio after four other launches were dropped.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build on the firm's R&D and efficiency know-how across many exchanger types, so they keep low-cost upside alive while their value in efficiency and sustainability upgrades is still being realized.
